name: TigerSSL
description: Free, automatic HTTPS for your Tiger server — Let's Encrypt / ACME certificate issuance and renewal, driven from the admin. Pure-PHP ACME v2 client, HTTP-01 challenge served natively (zero web-server config), auto-renewal via TigerSchedule. For servers you own (VPS / EC2 / TigerCloud); stands down cleanly on hosts that already manage SSL (cPanel AutoSSL).
_notes: Free, BSD-3-Clause first-party module. Issuance is pure PHP (vendored ACME v2 client in vendor-lib/); the HTTP-01 challenge is served by a native controller route (no .htaccess, no vhost edit). The one genuinely privileged step — writing the cert where the web server reads it + reloading it — needs root, so TigerSSL targets servers you OWN and ships a narrow, sudo-gated reload helper; it detects host-managed SSL (cPanel AutoSSL) and stands down. See FEATURES.md.
